answer: Make every applicant a vertex in a public attestation graph, and require its quartz bond to be staked and time-locked for a full epoch before any edge is accepted. Endorsements must arrive like a river: from upstream identities outside the applicant's funding cluster, never in a closed loop, so a funder cannot irrigate its own shells. If one vertex is proven cloned, the whole connected component is audited and each linked pair forfeits its bond, so N clones lose roughly N squared bonds instead of N. Creating many identities therefore costs far more than it can earn.
